sections.title: Workflows
sections.description: One row per workflow (forge.ai.workflow.name). Model calls outside any workflow are the (none) row.

sections.title: Inside a workflow
sections.description: The model calls of each node (forge.ai.node.id) and agent (gen_ai.agent.name).

title: shop: AI by workflow
description: Each workflow's runs, success, duration, model calls and tokens per run, and within a workflow, each node and agent. From the GenAI spans in the environment's traces, so the range is bounded by their retention.

panels.title: Workflows
panels.description: Runs, the success rate of finished runs, run duration, and model calls, tokens and reported cost per run, with the model the workflow called most (ties go to the last by name).
panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,
         toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd'])) AS cost, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] AS workflow, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] AS run_id,
         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,
         SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS user_id, SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS org_id
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost
  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id),
top AS (
  SELECT workflow, argMax(model, (n, model)) AS top_model
  FROM (SELECT workflow, model, count() AS n FROM ai WHERE is_call GROUP BY workflow, model)
  GROUP BY workflow)
SELECT if(r.wf = '', '(none)', r.wf) AS "Workflow", count() AS "Runs", round(countIf(outcome = 'Succeeded') / nullIf(countIf(outcome IN ('Succeeded', 'Failed')), 0), 4) AS "Success rate",
       round(quantileIf(0.5)(seconds, outcome != 'In progress'), 1) AS "p50 s",
       round(quantileIf(0.95)(seconds, outcome != 'In progress'), 1) AS "p95 s",
       round(avg(calls), 1) AS "Calls / run", round(avg(run_in + run_out)) AS "Tokens / run",
       sum(run_in + run_out) AS "Tokens", round(sum(run_cost), 4) AS "Reported cost (USD)",
       any(t.top_model) AS "Top model"
FROM runs AS r LEFT JOIN top AS t ON t.workflow = r.wf
GROUP BY r.wf ORDER BY "Runs" DESC, "Workflow" LIMIT 50

panels.title: Runs by workflow
panels.description: Runs each UTC day by workflow: the ten workflows with the most runs in the range, the rest as Other.
panels.sql:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, TraceId, SpanName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration,
         SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] AS op, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AS is_call, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' AS is_tool, (StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled') AS failed,
         if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.response.model'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.request.model']) AS model, if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.provider.name'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.system']) AS provider,
         toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) AS in_tok, toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) AS out_tok, toUInt64OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'] != '', SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'], SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'])) AS cache_read_tok,
         toFloat64OrNull(if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'] != '', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.cost.usd'], SpanAttributes['reliant.cost_usd'])) AS cost, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] AS workflow, SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] AS run_id,
         SpanAttributes['error.type'] AS error_type, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] AS tool,
         SpanAttributes['user.id'] AS user_id, SpanAttributes['org.id'] AS org_id
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != '' OR SpanAttributes['forge.ai.run.id'] != '')),
runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, anyIf(workflow, workflow != '') AS wf,
         min(ts) AS started, max(addNanoseconds(ts, Duration)) AS ended,
         (toUnixTimestamp64Nano(ended) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(started)) / 1e9 AS seconds,
         countIf(op = 'invoke_workflow') AS segments,
         multiIf(segments = 0, 'In progress',
                 argMaxIf(error_type, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow') = 'canceled', 'Cancelled',
                 argMaxIf(failed, ts, op = 'invoke_workflow'), 'Failed', 'Succeeded') AS outcome,
         countIf(is_call) AS calls, countIf(is_tool) AS tools,
         sumIf(in_tok, is_call) AS run_in, sumIf(out_tok, is_call) AS run_out, sumIf(cost, is_call) AS run_cost
  FROM ai WHERE run_id != '' GROUP BY run_id),
top AS (SELECT wf FROM runs GROUP BY wf ORDER BY count() DESC, wf LIMIT 10)
SELECT toDate(started) AS day, if(wf IN (SELECT wf FROM top), if(wf = '', '(none)', wf), 'Other') AS workflow, count() AS "Runs"
FROM runs GROUP BY day, workflow ORDER BY day, workflow

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Each node's model calls, tokens and failed calls, by workflow. A node a loop revisits counts every visit.
panels.sql:
SELECT if(SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name'] = '', '(none)', SpanAttributes['forge.ai.workflow.name']) AS "Workflow", SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] AS "Node",
       count() AS "Calls", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS "Input tokens", sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS "Output tokens",
       countIf((StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND SpanAttributes['error.type'] != 'canceled')) AS "Failed calls", round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS "p95 ms"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'] AND SpanAttributes['forge.ai.node.id'] != ''
GROUP BY "Workflow", "Node" ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Each agent's turns (invoke_agent spans), and the model calls and tokens under them, by agent name (gen_ai.agent.name).
panels.sql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name'] AS "Agent",
       countIf(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent') AS "Turns", countIf(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']) AS "Calls",
       sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']) AS "Input tokens", sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings']) AS "Output tokens",
       round(quantileIf(0.95)(Duration / 1e6, SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent')) AS "Turn p95 ms"
FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND SpanAttributes['gen_ai.agent.name'] != '' AND (SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'invoke_agent' OR SpanAttributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] IN ['chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content', 'embeddings'])
GROUP BY "Agent" ORDER BY "Calls" DESC LIMIT 50
